L3 prescribes the usize nonnegative-domain bridge but also requires acceptance of equivalently exact derivations. F establishes len as usize yet derives positivity from its separately stated element-count/natural-count meaning without a usize-domain entry; the packet does not unambiguously say whether that substitutes for the prescribed bridge, so the split raw L3 decision is not challenged.

L8 requires unambiguous references to checked authority propositions but does not say whether the adjacent comment itself must contain URLs or axiom labels. Direct method/contract names were treated as sufficient when the surrounding report actually contains a complete checked inventory; E/F fail for missing checked numeric entries independently of this formatting ambiguity.

The packet does not specify a transcription format for such signatures; this review distinguishes an expressly inspected displayed signature from G's unquoted/misclassified len-return-type assertion.
